boundary: Operational and synthetic workflow evidence only; failed witnesses remain retained and same-owner passing witnesses are not independent reproduction.

records.failed_witness: A pipeline-scoped $_ value was read outside its pipeline and produced a null LiteralPath.
records.passing_witness: The scalar path read returned the intended file.
records.recovery: Use the known literal scalar path directly.
records.recurrence_guard: Never rely on $_ outside the active pipeline block.
records.rollback: No repository mutation occurred.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use literal-path scalar probes for known files.

records.failed_witness: Unquoted HEAD...@{u} was parsed by PowerShell and mangled instead of reaching Git literally.

records.recurrence_guard: Quote revision syntax containing braces.
records.rollback: No repository mutation occurred.
records.sibling_recommendation: Treat Git revision expressions as literal arguments.

records.failed_witness: An overescaped word-count regular expression returned zero for the activation baton.
records.passing_witness: The corrected count was 39557 words.

records.recurrence_guard: Test regex quoting on a tiny fixture before a long-file count.
records.rollback: The zero count received no credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Prefer a small explicit word-count function over shell-escaping layers.

records.failed_witness: Large activation-baton display windows were truncated at six locations.

records.rollback: Do not claim EOF until every truncated interval is recovered.
records.sibling_recommendation: Record missing line ranges immediately when a display truncates.

records.failed_witness: The first packet build selected the extensionless Codex npm shim for a direct subprocess version probe and Windows refused execution.
records.passing_witness: The recovered version-only probe returned the installed Codex CLI version.
records.recovery: Select the explicit codex.cmd shim and keep OSError fail-soft for version-only metadata.
records.recurrence_guard: Use an explicit executable suffix for Windows command shims.
records.rollback: The partial generated packet received zero build or validation credit and was deterministically rebuilt.
records.sibling_recommendation: Resolve Windows shim type before direct subprocess execution.

records.failed_witness: A repeated pre-evidence packet build counted the pre-existing builder receipt and then added one again, producing a non-stable generated-file count.
records.passing_witness: Repeated packet builds now preserve one exact generated-file count and file list.
records.recovery: Exclude the self-referential receipt during discovery, then append its literal path exactly once.
records.recurrence_guard: Handle self-describing receipt paths explicitly instead of relying on prior filesystem state.
records.rollback: The inconsistent pre-evidence count received zero validation credit and was replaced additively before commit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Test build metadata from both an absent and pre-existing receipt state.

records.failed_witness: The first roster-validator invocation supplied the state path positionally although the validate subcommand requires --state.
records.passing_witness: The corrected validator invocation parsed the intended roster state.
records.recovery: Inspect the validate subcommand interface and pass the same literal state path through --state.
records.recurrence_guard: Read subcommand-specific help before invoking a multi-command CLI.
records.rollback: The argument-parser failure earned zero validation credit and changed no state.
records.sibling_recommendation: Treat top-level help and subcommand help as separate contracts.

records.failed_witness: The first migrated roster retained Neris as current_owner_executor while its current route already named Vesper.
records.passing_witness: Auth and roster validators both returned valid with Vesper as the owner-scoped executor.
records.recovery: Patch the single attributable executor field to Vesper and rerun both structural state validators.
records.recurrence_guard: Cross-check current route owner against validation_scope.execution_authority.current_owner_executor.
records.rollback: The inconsistent intermediate state received zero route or validation credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Validate auth and roster together immediately after every live-owner transition.

records.failed_witness: The first expanded mutation suite expected a normalization_collisions key although the public payload contract names it nfc_collisions.
records.passing_witness: The corrected NFC-equivalent path mutation was rejected and its collision was counted once.
records.recovery: Inspect the actual bounded payload and assert the stable nfc_collisions field.
records.recurrence_guard: Inspect real result keys before writing projections or assertions.
records.rollback: The 42-pass plus one-error suite earned zero aggregate success credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Keep public receipt field names in test fixtures literal and schema-derived.

records.failed_witness: A diagnostic attempted to print a combining Unicode character through the Windows cp1252 console and raised UnicodeEncodeError.
records.passing_witness: The ASCII-escaped diagnostic exposed the exact nfc_collisions field and invalid path.
records.recovery: Render diagnostic JSON with ensure_ascii enabled while preserving the underlying Unicode input.
records.recurrence_guard: Escape non-ASCII diagnostic output when the active Windows console encoding is not UTF-8.
records.rollback: The display failure changed no repository or global state and earned zero validation credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Separate Unicode test semantics from terminal rendering semantics.
